repair_loop.what: the refusal is structured (rule, line, numbers), so it can be turned into an instruction and applied with no model in the way. Two claims: every refusal is actionable, and the loop terminates because the gate says so.

instructions.detail: line 6: rapid passes through material at (26.51,-16.92,-2.00) where the stock top is 0.00
instructions.fix: Every lateral rapid must be taken at or above the safe Z. Insert a retract to safe Z before the offending lateral move, and a plunge back down after.

instructions.detail: line 5: holder bottom Z=-1.50 is inside stock (top 0.00) -- stickout 20.0 mm with 21.5 mm of stock above the tip
instructions.fix: The flutes ran out: the holder entered the stock. Either reduce the depth or use a tool with more stickout -- this is the number a prompt rarely has.

instructions.detail: line 5: Z -21.500 is below the table face at -10.000
instructions.fix: The tool tip went below the table face. Raise the depth by at least the overshoot, or reduce the requested depth.

loops.why: unrepairable by this rule set: holder_crash,table_crash

repair_loop.honest: shortsighted is NOT repaired: its error is geometric (a cut deeper than the tool reaches) and reordering its moves cannot fix it, so the loop stops and says so instead of reporting a success it does not have.
